intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of an Emergency Locator Transmitter?
Define the basic theory of radio communication.
Identify the frequency band used by the SLB ELT system.

development.content:
Definition of SLB ELT System
Activation mechanisms and triggers
Signal transmission protocols
Frequency allocation details
Distress signal characteristics

Function of emergency radio systems
Integration with aircraft safety systems
Operational limitations and constraints
Maintenance and testing requirements
Regulatory compliance standards

Comparison with other emergency systems
Real-world application scenarios
Troubleshooting common failures
Future developments in ELT technology
Safety implications for aircrew

summary_questions: Explain the function of the SLB ELT in an emergency scenario.
Describe the operational limitations of the emergency radio system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the integration of the SLB ELT with future aircraft safety systems to be submitted in the next lesson plan.
